title: A new classmate
instructions: Elif ve Marco dil kursunda tanışıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; ülke, dil ve hobilere dikkat et.

script.speaker: elif
script.text: Hi! Are you new in this class? I'm Elif.

script.speaker: marco
script.text: Hi, Elif. Yes, it's my first day. My name is Marco.

script.speaker: elif
script.text: Nice to meet you, Marco. Where are you from?

script.speaker: marco
script.text: I'm from Brazil, from a city called Recife. And you?

script.speaker: elif
script.text: I'm from Turkey. I live in Ankara with my parents.

script.speaker: elif
script.text: Turkish, of course, and a little German. Now I want to learn English.

script.speaker: marco
script.text: Me too. I speak Portuguese and Spanish.

script.speaker: elif
script.text: Wow, that's great! What do you do in your free time?

script.speaker: marco
script.text: I play football and I cook. I love cooking Brazilian food.

script.speaker: elif
script.text: I don't cook, but I love eating! I play the guitar and I read a lot.

script.speaker: marco
script.text: Maybe you can come to my house for dinner one day.

questions.evidence: I'm from Brazil, from a city called Recife.

questions.feedback: Elif Ankara'da ailesiyle (with my parents) yaşıyor.
questions.evidence: I live in Ankara with my parents.

questions.prompt: Which language does Elif speak a little?
questions.feedback: Elif biraz Almanca (a little German) konuşuyor. İspanyolca ve Portekizce Marco'nun dilleri.
questions.evidence: Turkish, of course, and a little German.

questions.prompt: What does Elif do in her free time?
options: She plays the guitar and reads.
questions.feedback: Elif gitar çalıyor ve çok kitap okuyor. Yemek yapmıyor (I don't cook); futbol ve yemek Marco'nun hobileri.
questions.evidence: I play the guitar and I read a lot.
